full_judgment: 2. The allegations of the opposite party 2, informant as averred in the first information report and in the charge sheet, in short, are that on 10-1-93 on the basis of a written agreement, the accused persons for the purpose of joint business, received Tk.10 lac in cash from the informant and on the same date they also received Taka 1 (one) lace from the informant assuring him that his son Hanif Md Chowdhury who obtained M Com, decree would be given a service in Saudi Arabia. Later on also they received Taka 40,000.00 from the son of the informant namely, Captain Iftekar Ahmed for the purpose of service of the son of the informant. So in total both the accused persons jointly received Taka 11,40,000.00 from the informant on false assurance of the aforesaid purposes. But the same amount has been totally misappropriated by way of deception and on false representation neither business has been started nor the son of the informant has been provided with any service and also no attempt has been even made for the same as yet. So, from the inception the accused petitioners had the intention for deceiving the informant and to misappropriate the good money of the informant.
